instruction:
You are a plan-primary minting CEF v0.1.0 wave agent_tasks. Do NOT treat docs/reports/dual-seat as CEF.

FILL-INS per remesure: FREEZE_SHA, AGENT_RUN_ID (e.g. AGENT_AC), SEAT_AGENT_ID (antigravity-1|2),
PERSONA (PER-ORCH-ALPHA|BETA), OUTPUT_HOME (docs/quality/cef-runs/<date>-<AGENT_RUN_ID>),
BLI (usually BLI-CEF-R27-DUAL-SEAT-REMEASURE-001), BRANCH (plan branch_ref), CVS (CVS-CEF-UNTIL-45-001).

For EACH wave 0..4 create one agent_task (title CEF <run> <AGENT_RUN_ID> Wave N …) with:
- backlog_item_ref=BLI, branch_ref=BRANCH, assignee_persona_ref=PERSONA
- description MUST require: follow docs/quality/codebase_evaluation/KICKOFF_PROMPT.md (+ filled kickoff),
  write ALL CEF artifacts under OUTPUT_HOME only, specialist THEN adversarial per lens,
  diamond axes RDB MNT TST REL OBS RCV SEC ROB only (no GPA), no process mint, no app source edits,
  no reading the other seat package until Wave 4.
Wave artifact minimums:
  0: run_scope.yaml preflight.json tooling_gaps.md run_log.md diagrams/**
  1: findings+adversarial for L-ARCHITECTURE L-SECURITY L-SUPPLY-RELEASE
  2: findings+adversarial for L-RELIABILITY L-OBSERVABILITY L-CONCURRENCY L-PERFORMANCE
  3: findings+adversarial for L-CODE-QUALITY L-TESTING L-USABILITY L-DOCS-MODEL
  4: full package + scorecard.json + findings.jsonl + handoff_manifest.json + EXECUTIVE_NARRATIVE.md
Steer seats with NAMED ATK ids (WFL-SUBAGENT-DISPATCH). One wave at a time; hourglass --await-peer-ack.
After Wave 4: update matrix cef_diamond_scorecard rows for the seat + ENVELOPE; append CVS activity.
Score SSOT: zqk matrix report --name cef_diamond_scorecard (CSV docs/quality/CEF_DIAMOND_SCORECARD_MATRIX.csv).
title: CEF wave executor — mintable ATK recipe (per seat × wave)

instruction:
Repeatable dual-seat CEF remesure bound to CVS-CEF-UNTIL-45-001 and CRIT-CEF-R27-DRIVERS-001.

1) Freeze: git rev-parse HEAD; write docs/quality/cef-runs/<date>-FREEZE.md; add pending rows to
   docs/quality/CEF_DIAMOND_SCORECARD_MATRIX.csv (seat_a, seat_b, ENVELOPE) with package_complete=pending.
2) Kickoff files: fill KICKOFF_PROMPT identities only (AGENT_A/B dirs under cef-runs).
3) Hand AGI "CEF wave executor" to plan-primary to mint 5 ATKs × 2 seats (Wave 0–4). TPM does not babysit ATKs.
4) Hourglass Wave 0 steers with named ATKs; advance waves only after prior gate + peer_ack substance.
5) Forbidden evidence: docs/reports/dual-seat/* checklist GPA.
6) On both Wave 4 complete: write COMPARE.md; matrix-update grades + package_complete=yes + envelope_min;
   zqk matrix report --name cef_diamond_scorecard; append CVS-CEF-UNTIL-45-001 activity_log with freeze + vector.
7) Gate: ENVELOPE envelope_min >= 4 (target 4.5). Until then keep PRI-CEF-R27-ENVELOPE-001 sealed; succession
   active_order 1=REQ-RESIDUAL 2=TECH-DEBT 3=MESH 4=OPENCORE waits.
title: CEF dual-seat remesure — TPM/orch runbook (repeatable)
